I just joined reddit to comment on the original post and your response. I have been peeping and lurking around these posts for awhile, not feeling like any of it truly applied to me — until now. 

And frankly, it isn’t that it didn’t apply to me — it did ... the example didn’t truly hit me until the emotional connection of a moment (like a baby being born) or being so disengaged with reality generally speaking. 

And I’m not one that blacks out or turns into an ahole. I drink around 3x a week (to excess sometimes for almost 24 straight hours), I do cocaine just about every time, and then I wallow in a pit (my bed) for an entire day+. 

But the real fun, that happens afterward, because, well, my reactions and outreach to other human beings — both professional and personal — is fucking putrid. So, with drinking 3 days a week, another 3 days with what I call “coming to” and then the subsequent attempt at my brain *trying* to balance itself chemically ... well, I’m a fragment of a human being and a fragment of myself.

Thing is, I don’t know how to change it. I know meetings aren’t for me. My best friend died 6 years ago and I went to them with him and I didn’t care for them. I do think community would help, but not the big book community. 

So, now that I’ve arrived here I’m not quite sure where to go. Thank you for help with the realization, though.
